# COSHUMA

> Independent AI and SaaS buyer guides focused on pricing, trials, comparisons, buyer fit, and clearly disclosed partner routes.

COSHUMA separates editorial product information from affiliate destinations. Product prices, trial terms, and outbound destinations can change; use the linked vendor source on each guide to verify final terms before purchase.

High-intent guides below prioritize concrete buying questions such as free trials, pricing, discounts and plan fit. A listed partner route means COSHUMA has evidence for that customer-facing route; it does not imply a signup, sale, commission or revenue event occurred.
